Subject: Public health alert: 3 Cholera cases in 7 days in Kisumu County

Possible Cholera outbreak in Kisumu County

Afiax has counted 3 Cholera cases in 7 days in Kisumu County, recorded by Kisumu Lakeside Hospital. That reaches the alert threshold of 3 cases, so it may be an outbreak and needs a response now.

You're getting this because this address is on the outbreak alert list for Kisumu Lakeside Hospital.

  Disease:               Cholera (ICD-11 1A00)
  Where:                 Kisumu County
  Cases:                 3, of which 1 confirmed
  First and last case:   14 Nov 2026 to 19 Nov 2026
  Alert rule:            3 or more Cholera cases within 7 days in the same county
  Detected:              19 Nov 2026, 10:42 EAT
  Event reference:       PHE-20261119-cholera-county-9a8b7c6d

THE CASES

  1. 14 Nov 2026 · confirmed · male, age 34 · Kisumu Central, Kisumu · Kisumu Lakeside Hospital
  2. 16 Nov 2026 · provisional · female, age 29 · Nyando, Kisumu · Ahero Sub-County Hospital
  3. 19 Nov 2026 · provisional · female, age 61 · Kisumu East, Kisumu · Kisumu Lakeside Hospital

Names, ID numbers and contact details are left out to protect patients. Staff at the facilities that recorded them can see the full records in Afiax.

WHAT TO DO NOW

1. Notify the Sub-County and County Disease Surveillance Coordinators immediately
2. Verify the cases and collect specimens for laboratory confirmation
3. Conduct active case search and line-list all cases
4. Institute control measures appropriate to the disease

If you have an Afiax account at Kisumu Lakeside Hospital, the event report with links to each case is here:
https://app.afiax.africa/DocumentReference/7a1b2c3d-0000-4c1b-8a3e-2f6d7c8b9a01

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Afiax has opened a public health event and a follow-up task for Kisumu Lakeside Hospital. If more Cholera cases are recorded in Kisumu County while the event is open, they're added to it. You won't get a separate email for each one.

QUESTIONS?
